scope: local simulated prototype; paint-opportunity timing is a proxy, not physical display latency
limitations: Browser render measurement ends at a double requestAnimationFrame paint opportunity, not a physical compositor timestamp.
Samples cover rendered snapshots; React may coalesce intervening updates. Map DOM updates can occur below the viewport.
Local existing dependency installation used; no fresh machine installation or Docker run.
No 24-72 hour soak; history size is a short-run observation.
Separate ingestion microservice deployment and real train feeds are not implemented.
